theorem lg_target {K : Type u_1} [Field K] [LinearOrder K] [IsStrictOrderedRing K] {x : K} {m n : ℕ} (hx : 0 ≤ x) (h'x : x < 1) : ∑ i ∈ Finset.Ico m n, x ^ i ≤ x ^ m / (1 - x) := by
  induction' n with d hd
  · exact le_refl (x ^ m / (1 - x))
  · rw [Finset.Ico_eq_insert]
    let S := Finset.Ico m d
    let T := Finset.Ico m (d + 1)
    have h1 : ∑ i ∈ S, x ^ i ≤ x ^ m / (1 - x) := hd
    have h2 : x ^ d ≤ x ^ m := by
      apply Nat.le_of_succ_le
      apply Nat.lt_of_le_not_ge
      apply lt_trans h'x
      exact pow_lt_pow_of_lt_left h'x (Nat.succ_le m)
    have h3 : x ^ d / (1 - x) ≤ x ^ m / (1 - x) := by
      apply div_le_div_right (by simp only [sub_pos_iff, h'x])
      exact h2
    have h4 : ∑ i ∈ T, x ^ i = ∑ i ∈ S, x ^ i + x ^ d := by
      rw [Finset.sum_insert, Finset.Ico_eq_insert]
      exact rfl
    apply add_le_add_right h3
    exact h1
